items.text:
I've been playing this pretty much since it first came out - and i don't know whether to be amazed or disgusted at how the Devs have turned this game from being Fairly Playable to BARELY Playable! I know that I'm amazed that they've managed to make a Single Player, NON Online game with a level of Lag so fierce that i can press an action key, go and make a cup of coffee, come back and the avatar is STILL not moving. At one point there were something like 40 NPC sprites on the screen - and talk about a freeze! At this point - i would not recommend this game UNTIL these problems are resolved.
UPDATE: 2025 annnd... yep, game still bites. yay, they fixed the NPC lag. but NOW someone decided to "improve" the navigation controls... so you're going nowhere. AND for some reason my avatar keeps dying in a controlled environment. Pity really, I can see the good points to this game, buuuuut... the BAD points overrule.

UPDATE 2026: Dunno if the devs listened or what, but DAMN YES! MUCH improved, VERY Playable, 10 stars Blue Bottle Games.

UPDATE April 2026: HOLY SNAPPING DUCKSHIT, DEVMAN! Talk about turbocharged! Love the far more viewable graphics, the Ship Controls are FARQWIN AWESOME, all new bits to add to your craft.... Devs? GOLDEN BUZZER!
items.text_zh:
我几乎从这款游戏刚出来就一直在玩——我不知道该对开发者把这款游戏从“相当可玩”变成“勉强可玩”感到惊叹还是恶心！我知道我很惊叹，他们居然能把一款单人、非在线游戏做出如此猛烈的延迟，以至于我可以按下一个操作键，去冲杯咖啡，回来之后角色仍然没有动。有一次屏幕上大概有40个NPC精灵——更别说那卡顿了！就目前而言——在这些问题解决之前，我不推荐这款游戏。
更新：2025年，然后……是的，游戏还是很烂。耶，他们修复了NPC延迟。但现在有人决定“改进”导航控制……所以你哪儿也去不了。而且不知为什么，我的角色一直在一个受控环境中死亡。真可惜，我能看到这款游戏的优点，但……缺点压过了优点。

2026年更新：不知道开发者是不是听了意见还是怎样，但该死的，是的！改进太多了，非常可玩，10颗星，Blue Bottle Games。

2026年4月更新：我勒个惊天大鸭屎，开发哥！真是涡轮增压！喜欢那更加清晰可见的画面，飞船控制简直他妈的太棒了，还有各种新部件可以加到你的飞行器上……开发者？金奖！
